title: Compact-support projection maps commute with open base restriction
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the small etale sites with the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All schemes mentioned are Noetherian [def-pc-scheme]. Compact-support direct image is the compactification-independent functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $f:X\to S$ be separated finite type and compactifiable [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $u:U\hookrightarrow S$ be open, and write $X_U=X\times_SU$, $v:X_U\hookrightarrow X$, and $f_U:X_U\to U$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion]. For $K\in D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ write $P_{f,K,M}:K\otimes_A^LRf_!M\to Rf_!(f^*K\otimes_A^LM)$ for the compactified tensor projection map, using the proper map [def-kun-projection-formula-map] and the open tensor map [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor]. Let $C_{f,u}:u^*Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{U!}v^*$ be the canonical compact-support exchange of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], normalized on the proper factor by [def-kun-unbounded-exchange] and on the open factor by [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map]. After the canonical monoidal pullback identifications,
$$C_{f,u,f^*K\otimes M}\circ u^*P_{f,K,M}
=P_{f_U,u^*K,v^*M}\circ(1_{u^*K}\otimes C_{f,u,M}).$$
The equality is for the actual compactified derived maps, is independent of compactification, and holds without boundedness or finite Tor-amplitude assumptions. If the projection maps are isomorphisms their inverses satisfy the corresponding identity.

proof.text: Let A be a finite commutative ring, let f:X→S be separated finite type and compactifiable between Noetherian schemes, let u:U↪S be open, and put X_U=X×_S U with projection v:X_U→X and map f_U:X_U→U. For K∈D(S_et,A) and M∈D(X_et,A), specialize the general compact-support projection/exchange identity [lem-asd-compact-projection-exchange] to the base-change morphism u. Its cartesian pullback is X_U, its exchange b_M is the compactified exchange C_{f,u,M}, and its projection map Π is the compactified map P_{f,K,M}; the canonical pullback/tensor identifications in that statement are exactly those displayed here. This gives the required equality for any chosen compactification and its base change.

proof.text: The chosen-compactification maps in the specialization are the maps named in the item: [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] says that compact-support direct image is independent of compactification and that, on a chosen compactification, the exchange is the proper exchange followed by the inverse degreewise open-extension comparison. [def-amb-etale-compact-support] identifies the compactified functor with Rr_* Dj_!, while [def-weil-pbc-etale-shriek-base-change-map] supplies the normalized open extension comparison. The derived open tensor factor is the canonical natural isomorphism of [lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor], and all displayed pullback/tensor transports are the canonical monoidal comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Therefore the specialized equality is the equality of the actual compactified derived maps, and refinement independence transports it to the canonical C and P of the statement.

If the four projection maps in the displayed equality are isomorphisms, compose the equality on the appropriate sides with their inverses and with the inverse exchange isomorphisms. Associativity of composition then gives the stated identity for the inverses; this is the elementary cancellation argument in any category.
